description.p: Soplos AppImage Manager integrates AppImage applications into the Soplos Linux desktop. It moves AppImages to ~/AppImages/, extracts their icon and metadata, creates menu entries for them, and checks GitHub, GitLab and Codeberg for updates.

El Gestor de AppImage de Soplos integra aplicaciones AppImage en el escritorio de Soplos Linux. Mueve los paquetes a ~/AppImages/, extrae sus iconos y metadatos, crea accesos en el menú de aplicaciones y comprueba actualizaciones en GitHub, GitLab y Codeberg.

Le gestionnaire d'AppImage de Soplos intègre les applications AppImage sur le bureau Soplos Linux. Il déplace les fichiers vers ~/AppImages/, extrait leurs icônes et métadonnées, crée des entrées de menu et vérifie les mises à jour sur GitHub, GitLab et Codeberg.

Die Soplos AppImage-Verwaltung integriert AppImage-Anwendungen in den Soplos Linux Desktop. Sie verschiebt Dateien nach ~/AppImages/, extrahiert Icons und Metadaten, erstellt Menüeinträge und prüft GitHub, GitLab und Codeberg auf Aktualisierungen.

O Gestor de AppImage do Soplos integra aplicações AppImage no ambiente de trabalho do Soplos Linux. Move os ficheiros para ~/AppImages/, extrai ícones e metadados, cria entradas de menu e verifica atualizações no GitHub, GitLab e Codeberg.

Il Gestore AppImage di Soplos integra le applicazioni AppImage nel desktop di Soplos Linux. Sposta i file in ~/AppImages/, estrae icone e metadati, crea voci di menu e controlla gli aggiornamenti su GitHub, GitLab e Codeberg.

Managerul AppImage Soplos integrează aplicațiile AppImage pe desktopul Soplos Linux. Mută fișierele în ~/AppImages/, extrage pictogramele și metadatele, creează intrări în meniu și verifică actualizările pe GitHub, GitLab și Codeberg.

Менеджер AppImage Soplos интегрирует приложения AppImage в рабочий стол Soplos Linux. Перемещает файлы в ~/AppImages/, извлекает значки и метаданные, создаёт пункты меню и проверяет обновления на GitHub, GitLab и Codeberg.

description.p: The application metadata points to the installed launcher, and there is a new screenshot of the list of AppImages.
The window no longer has the frame of the system: it is a card with rounded corners and its own minimize, maximize and close buttons.
New application icon, new hero image and new screenshots, taken with the interface in English.
The window follows the light or dark theme of the desktop (Xfce, Plasma and GNOME); the button of the window still lets you choose.

ul.li: Manual page rewritten and installed compressed
AppStream categories and keywords in 8 languages; developer and project group identifiers now org.soplos; screenshots use web addresses
Debian copyright declares Lucide (ISC), used for the interface icons

description.p: Full 8-language internationalization across desktop launchers and AppStream metadata.
Added Unix manual page documentation (soplos-appimage-manager.1) installed to /usr/share/man/man1/.
Registered MIME type handlers for AppImage files and updated Debian packaging metadata.

First beta of Soplos AppImage Manager 3.0. Detects already-installed AppImages instead of creating duplicates, shows errors in a visible dialog, and fixes a memory exhaustion bug in metadata extraction along with several process-isolation issues when launching AppImages.

ul.li: Fixed downloading an update failing on any AppImage larger than 10MB

description.p: Full architecture rewrite of Soplos AppImage Manager, from Python 3 and GTK3 to Tauri 2 with a Rust backend and a Svelte frontend.
